abstract: The Gini index is a widely reported measure of income inequality. Because the underlying microdata are often confidential, releasing the Gini index may leak information. We present an approach for bounding this information leakage by releasing a differentially private version of the Gini index. In doing so, we analyze how adding, deleting, or altering a single observation in any specific dataset can affect the computation of the Gini index; this is known as the local sensitivity. We then derive a smooth upper bound on the local sensitivity. Using this bound, we define a mechanism that adds noise to the Gini index, thereby satisfying differential privacy. Using simulated and genuine income data, we show that the mechanism can reduce the errors from noise injection substantially relative to differentially private algorithms that rely on the global sensitivity, that is, the maximum of the local sensitivities over all possible datasets. We characterize settings where using smooth sensitivity can provide highly accurate estimates, as well as settings where the noise variance is simply too large to provide reliably useful results. We also present a post-processing step that provides interval estimates about the value of the Gini index computed with the confidential data.
abstract_zh: 基尼指数是衡量收入不平等的一个广泛报道的指标。由于底层微观数据往往具有保密性，发布基尼指数可能会泄露信息。我们提出了一种方法，通过发布基尼指数的差分隐私版本来限制这种信息泄露。在此过程中，我们分析了在任意特定数据集中添加、删除或修改单个观测值如何影响基尼指数的计算；这被称为局部敏感性。随后，我们推导出局部敏感性的平滑上界。利用这一上界，我们定义了一种向基尼指数添加噪声的机制，从而满足差分隐私要求。通过模拟数据和真实收入数据，我们展示了该机制相对于依赖全局敏感性（即所有可能数据集上局部敏感性的最大值）的差分隐私算法，能够显著减少噪声注入带来的误差。我们刻画了使用平滑敏感性能够提供高精度估计的场景，以及噪声方差过大以至于无法提供可靠有用结果的场景。我们还提出了一种后处理步骤，用于提供关于基于保密数据计算的基尼指数值的区间估计。
title: Differentially Private Computation of the Gini Index for Income Inequality
title_zh: 收入不平等的基尼系数的差分隐私计算

abstract: High-dimensional time series are very common in reality. Analyzing each series separately may not be a good strategy, as it may miss some important information and result in a less optimal outcome. Even worse, in some cases, it may not even provide an answer to the question of interest. Reduced-rank model is an important tool for joint analysis of high-dimensional multiple-response time series. In this paper, we develop a new and powerful method for estimating the coefficient matrix of a multiple-response reduced-rank time series model based on factor models. With the help of the estimated factors, we also propose two statistics for testing the dependence of high-dimensional time series. Asymptotic results for the proposed estimators and tests are established. Intensive simulation studies show that the proposed procedure is more powerful than its alternatives. We also apply the proposed method to a real dataset to illustrate its usefulness in solving real-life problems.
abstract_zh: 高维时间序列在现实中非常普遍。单独分析每个序列可能并非良策，因为这可能会遗漏一些重要信息，导致结果不够优化。更糟的是，在某些情况下，甚至可能无法回答所关注的问题。降秩模型是对高维多响应时间序列进行联合分析的重要工具。本文基于因子模型，开发了一种新的且有效的方法来估计多响应降秩时间序列模型的系数矩阵。借助估计出的因子，我们还提出了两种统计量，用于检验高维时间序列的依赖性。针对所提出的估计量和检验，我们建立了渐近结果。大量模拟研究表明，所提出的方法比其替代方法更具效力。我们还将所提方法应用于一个真实数据集，以展示其在解决实际问题中的实用性。
title: Factor Model Based Estimation for High Dimensional Reduced-Rank Time Series
title_zh: 基于因子模型的高维降秩时间序列估计

abstract: We examine how enhanced reporting mandates influence insider trading in the presence of information asymmetry among corporate insiders. We develop an insider trading model in which headquarters executives (HQEXs) are less informed about divisional profitability than divisional managers (DMs) and release public reports subject to external auditing. Our model shows that, when insiders have incentives to report optimistically, enhanced reporting mandates can promote DMs' share purchases based on information not shared with HQEXs. We provide supporting evidence from difference-in-differences analyses using a regulatory shock to segment reporting obligations, namely the adoption of SFAS 131. Our study offers new insights for policymakers.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了在企业内部人之间存在信息不对称的情况下，加强报告要求如何影响内幕交易。我们构建了一个内幕交易模型，其中总部高管（HQEXs）对部门盈利能力的了解程度低于部门经理（DMs），并且发布需经外部审计的公开报告。我们的模型表明，当内部人有动机进行乐观报告时，加强报告要求可以促进部门经理基于未与总部高管共享的信息进行股票购买。我们利用分部报告义务的监管冲击，即SFAS 131的采纳，通过双重差分分析提供了支持性证据。我们的研究为政策制定者提供了新的见解。
title: Internal information asymmetry, external reporting, and insider trading: Theory and evidence
title_zh: 内部信息不对称、外部报告与内幕交易：理论与证据

abstract: The Inevitable Disclosure Doctrine (“IDD”) protects trade secrets and intellectual property but restricts labor mobility by limiting a worker's ability to take jobs at competing firms. Prior literature presents evidence of a causal relationship between the adoption of the IDD and earnings manipulation, as executives have less of a need to demonstrate superior performance to attract and retain employees. At the same time, however, the IDD traps executives in their roles, increasing their personal incentive to manage earnings defensively. We present evidence that executive incentives mitigate the desire to reduce earnings management in firms with lower knowledge-worker turnover after adopting the IDD, suggesting a more nuanced understanding of the relation between labor market mobility and accounting disclosure than has previously been documented.
abstract_zh: 不可避免披露原则（“IDD”）保护商业秘密和知识产权，但通过限制员工在竞争对手处任职的能力，制约了劳动力流动性。既有文献提供了IDD采纳与盈余操纵之间存在因果关系的证据，因为高管在吸引和留住员工方面不再需要展示卓越绩效。然而，与此同时，IDD将高管困于其职位之中，增强了他们防御性管理盈余的个人动机。我们提供的证据表明，在采纳IDD后知识型员工流动率较低的企业中，高管激励缓解了减少盈余管理的意愿，这表明劳动力市场流动性与会计披露之间的关系比以往文献所记载的更为微妙复杂。
title: Conflicting incentives: How the inevitable disclosure doctrine disparately influences disclosure
title_zh: 冲突激励：不可避免披露原则如何差异化影响信息披露

abstract: This study assesses how weather‐year‐dependent sheep and crop management tactics affect farm profitability and farm system greenhouse gas emissions in the central Great Southern region in Australia. To investigate the impact of farmers' tactical decisions on farm profit and emissions, a whole farm optimisation model known as the Australian Farm Optimisation Model is employed. The model describes a typical mixed enterprise farm, the weather‐year variation that underpins the farm system and the plethora of strategic and tactical management options available to the farm manager. Modelling results reveal that utilising all tactical management options increases expected farm profit by 26% and expected emissions increase by 11%; however, the emissions intensity with respect to farm profit is reduced. Access to tactical options can greatly improve profits and emissions intensity in particular types of weather‐years. Emission and profit outcomes are a combination of direct effects of individual tactics and the strategic structural shifts they trigger across the whole farm (enterprise mix, stocking rate), underscoring the value of whole‐farm optimisation models for guiding management and policy. The modelling results also reveal that assessing the value and emission impact of tactics depends on the other tactics already available to the farm manager. This indicates the need for whole farm system analysis if the stacking or bundling of tactical options in agricultural systems is to be properly understood and estimated.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了依赖天气年份的绵羊与作物管理策略如何影响澳大利亚大南部地区中部的农场盈利能力及农场系统温室气体排放。为探究农户战术决策对农场利润和排放的影响，采用了名为“澳大利亚农场优化模型”的整场优化模型。该模型描述了一个典型的混合经营农场，涵盖了支撑农场系统的天气年份变化，以及农场管理者可用的众多战略性和战术性管理选项。模型结果显示，利用所有战术管理选项可使预期农场利润增加26%，预期排放增加11%；然而，相对于农场利润的排放强度有所降低。在特定类型的天气年份中，获取战术选项能大幅提升利润并改善排放强度。排放与利润的结果是各战术直接效应与其引发的整个农场（企业组合、载畜量）战略结构调整的综合体现，这凸显了整场优化模型在指导管理和政策制定中的价值。模型结果还揭示，评估战术的价值和排放影响取决于农场管理者已可用的其他战术，这表明若要正确理解和估算农业系统中战术选项的叠加或捆绑效应，需进行整场系统分析。

title: Can Farmers' Tactical Decisions Jointly Lift Profits and Lower Emissions in a Mixed Enterprise Farm System?

abstract: The Visa‐Free Transit Policy is a major opening‐up initiative launched by China to eliminate barriers to cross‐border personnel mobility and build an interconnected cross‐border network. Using a sample of China's A‐share listed firms from 2006 to 2019, this paper adopts the Difference‐in‐Differences (DID) model to empirically examine whether the policy can effectively improve the innovation quality of firms in visa‐free transit cities. The results show that the policy significantly improves local firms' innovation quality. It can function via two mediating mechanisms: promoting corporate supply chain diversification and facilitating inter‐firm collaborative innovation. Heterogeneity analysis shows that its innovation‐boosting effect is stronger for three groups of firms: firms in regions with strong intellectual property protection, those in transportation hubs and small and medium‐sized enterprises (SMEs). In addition, the 144‐h visa‐free transit policy also exerts a significant positive effect on corporate innovation quality. However, the limited observation period and confounding effects of prior policies impede the accurate estimation of the policy's net effect.
abstract_zh: 免签过境政策是中国为消除跨境人员流动障碍、构建互联互通跨境网络而推出的重大开放举措。本文以2006年至2019年中国A股上市公司为样本，采用双重差分（DID）模型实证检验该政策能否有效提升免签过境城市企业的创新质量。研究结果表明，该政策显著提升了当地企业的创新质量。其作用机制主要有两条中介路径：促进企业供应链多元化以及推动企业间协同创新。异质性分析显示，该政策对三类企业的创新促进效应更为显著：知识产权保护力度较强地区的企业、交通枢纽城市的企业以及中小企业（SMEs）。此外，144小时免签过境政策对企业创新质量同样具有显著的正向影响。然而，有限的观测期及先前政策的混杂效应制约了对该政策净效应的精确估计。

abstract: We study the impact of techies—engineers and other technically trained workers—on firm‐level productivity. We first report new facts on techies in the firm using French administrative data. Techies are STEM‐skill intensive and associated with innovation, technology adoption, management, and diffusion within firms. Using structural econometric methods, we estimate the effect of techies on firm‐level Hicks‐neutral productivity in manufacturing and nonmanufacturing. We find that techies raise productivity, and that this effect goes beyond R&D workers, extending to ICT and other techies. In nonmanufacturing firms, the impact operates mostly through ICT and other techies, not R&D workers.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了技术人员——工程师及其他受过技术训练的工人——对企业层面生产率的影响。首先，我们利用法国行政数据报告了关于企业内部技术人员的新事实。技术人员高度集中于STEM技能，并与企业内部的创新、技术采纳、管理及知识扩散相关联。运用结构计量经济学方法，我们估算了技术人员对制造业和非制造业企业层面希克斯中性生产率的影响。我们发现技术人员能提升生产率，且这一效应超越了研发人员，延伸至信息技术及其他技术人员。在非制造业企业中，该影响主要通过信息技术及其他技术人员发挥作用，而非研发人员。
title: Techies and Firm‐Level Productivity
title_zh: 技术人员与企业生产率

abstract: The gradual rise in temperatures motivates conceptualizing climate change as a phenomenon shaping the propagation of macroeconomic shocks, rather than as an independent shock. We formalize this in a theoretical model, showing that climate change induces a structural shift by steepening the aggregate supply curve, exacerbating the price effects of demand shocks while dampening the output response. Our empirical evidence is consistent with this prediction: higher temperatures raise the share of inflation variation attributable to demand shocks by up to 10 percentage points, underscoring the role of climate change in intensifying stagflationary dynamics rather than independently driving business cycles.
abstract_zh: 气温的逐步上升促使我们将气候变化概念化为一种塑造宏观经济冲击传播的现象，而非独立冲击。我们在理论模型中对此进行了形式化，表明气候变化通过使总供给曲线更加陡峭引发结构性转变，加剧了需求冲击的价格效应，同时削弱了产出响应。我们的实证证据与这一预测一致：气温升高使需求冲击导致的通胀变动份额最多增加10个百分点，凸显了气候变化在加剧滞胀动态而非独立驱动商业周期中的作用。
title: Climate Change and Economic Dynamics: Temperature‐Dependent Shock Propagation
title_zh: 气候变化与经济动态：温度依赖的冲击传导

abstract: This study proposes a novel methodology to measure the stringency of building height regulations. This measure gauges the difference in building heights with and without regulations. The primary challenge is to recover unobserved building heights in the absence of regulations. I develop a dynamic discrete choice model of building height decision‐making by parcel owners and conduct a counterfactual experiment that removes height regulations. An application to residential buildings in central Tokyo presents three findings. Without height restrictions, the number of stories would increase by 2.7%, and housing prices would change by 3.7%. Regulatory stringency is stronger near the central area, while the static model tends to overestimate it.
abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种新颖的方法来衡量建筑高度管制的严格程度。该度量方法评估了有无管制情况下建筑高度的差异。主要挑战在于恢复无管制条件下未被观测到的建筑高度。我构建了一个地块所有者关于建筑高度决策的动态离散选择模型，并进行了一项反事实实验，即移除高度管制。以东京中心城区的住宅建筑为应用对象，研究得出三项发现：若无高度限制，楼层数将增加2.7%，房价将变动3.7%；管制严格程度在中心区域附近更为显著，而静态模型往往高估了这一严格程度。
title: Measuring the Stringency of Building Height Regulations
title_zh: 衡量建筑高度法规严格程度

abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model of firm dynamics with multiple labour skills to analyse the productivity implications of skill shortages. Firms employ cognitive, interpersonal, and manual skills in both operational and overhead tasks, with sectoral variation in skill intensities, and within sector firm size heterogeneity due to idiosyncratic technology draws. Calibrated to UK data, the model reveals that cognitive skills are a binding constraint on productivity. A reduction in the supply of cognitive skills lowers labour productivity at all levels – firms, sectors, and in the aggregate. About half of the sectoral effects are due to changes in the within-sector distribution, whereby larger firms grow in relative size but become less productive. Sectoral heterogeneity in skill intensities amplifies these effects.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含多种劳动技能的企业动态一般均衡模型，以分析技能短缺对生产率的影响。企业将认知、人际交往和手工技能用于运营及管理任务，各行业在技能密集度上存在差异，且行业内企业规模因特有技术冲击而呈现异质性。基于英国数据的校准结果显示，认知技能是生产率的约束性瓶颈。认知技能供给的减少会降低企业、行业及总体层面的劳动生产率。约一半的行业效应源于行业内分布的变化，即大型企业相对规模扩大但生产率下降。行业间技能密集度的异质性加剧了这些影响。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Worker Skills, Firm Dynamics, and Productivity
title_zh: 工人技能、企业动态与生产率

abstract: We estimate how the timing of parental job loss shapes children’s human capital by exploiting plant closures in Danish administrative data. We match treated children to observably similar untreated peers and difference out age-invariant selection using children whose parents are displaced after school completion. Job loss during infancy (ages 0–1) reduces ninth-grade mathematics achievement by 0.04 standard deviations and raises non-completion by one percentage point. Effects are smaller in later childhood. Treated infants are 1.4 percentage points less likely to enrol in general upper-secondary programs. We find that liquidity-constrained families drive these results, suggesting that transient income shocks create permanent educational scars.
abstract_zh: 我们利用丹麦行政数据中的工厂关闭事件，估计了父母失业时机如何影响子女人力资本。我们将受影响的儿童与观察特征相似且未受影响的同龄人进行匹配，并通过父母在子女完成学业后失业的儿童来差分消除年龄不变的筛选效应。婴儿期（0-1岁）父母失业使九年级数学成绩降低0.04个标准差，并使未完成学业的比例上升一个百分点。在儿童后期，影响较小。受影响的婴儿进入普通高中项目的可能性低1.4个百分点。我们发现，流动性受限家庭是这些结果的主要驱动因素，这表明暂时性的收入冲击会留下永久性的教育伤痕。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: When It Hurts the Most: Timing of Parental Job Loss and a Child’s Education,
title_zh: 父母失业时机与子女教育：最痛之时

abstract: Burdensome entry regulations can hinder productivity growth, particularly in services where competitive pressures are weaker. We construct a novel measure of entry regulation, varying across narrowly defined sectors, and combine it with firm-level data for the universe of Italian firms. Exploiting reforms that generate variation across sectors and over time, we find that deregulation (reductions in red tape) raises productivity. The effect is driven by incumbent firms, with a smaller role for reallocation and selection. Effects are larger in the lower-middle of the productivity distribution and in sectors with higher entry rates and tighter initial regulation.
abstract_zh: 繁重的准入规制可能阻碍生产率增长，尤其是在竞争压力较弱的服务业中。我们构建了一种新的准入规制衡量指标，该指标在细分行业间存在差异，并将其与意大利全部企业的企业层面数据相结合。利用跨行业及随时间变化的改革所带来的差异，我们发现放松规制（减少行政手续）能提升生产率。这一效应主要由在位企业驱动，而重新配置与选择机制的作用较小。在生产率分布的中低端以及进入率较高、初始规制较严格的行业中，效应更为显著。
title: Productivity and Entry Regulation in the Service Sector: Evidence from the Universe of Firms in Italy
title_zh: 服务业生产率与准入规制：来自意大利全量企业的证据

abstract: This study examines how configurations of public financial management performance, sectoral spending, and governance context shape education and health outcomes across developing and middle-income economies. Using fuzzy set qualitative comparative analysis and Bayesian robustness checks, the analysis identifies multiple sufficient pathways linking budget execution credibility to primary education, secondary education, universal health coverage, and under five mortality outcomes. The findings confirm that public financial management conditions operate through conjunctural combinations rather than linear channels, their explanatory reach is stronger for intermediate than longer term outcomes, and strong aggregate and revenue execution can compensate for low sectoral spending. Budget credibility at the execution stage emerges as the central operative mechanism.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了公共财政管理绩效、部门支出与治理环境的不同组合如何影响发展中及中等收入经济体的教育与健康成果。运用模糊集定性比较分析与贝叶斯稳健性检验，分析识别出多条充分路径，将预算执行可信度与初等教育、中等教育、全民健康覆盖及五岁以下儿童死亡率等结果联系起来。研究发现证实，公共财政管理条件通过组合性联动而非线性渠道发挥作用，其解释力对中期成果强于长期成果，且强劲的总量与收入执行可弥补部门支出的不足。执行阶段的预算可信度成为核心运作机制。

abstract: This paper uncovers some of the epistemic implications of stability in the presence of one-sided incomplete information. If it is not common knowledge that an allocation is not stable under complete information, the allocation must be stable under incomplete information, in the sense of Liu et al. (2014), regardless of the agents’ information and preferences. The converse does not necessarily hold, so that there can be common knowledge that an incomplete-information stable allocation is not complete-information stable, but is recovered within familiar information and preference domains. The characterization implies that incomplete-information stability is testable and observationally equivalent to its complete-information counterpart, and carries over to other well-known stability notions proposed in the literature.
abstract_zh: 本文揭示了在单边不完全信息背景下，稳定性所蕴含的某些认知意义。若在完全信息下，一项配置的不稳定性并非共同知识，则该配置在不完全信息下必定是稳定的，此处的稳定性遵循Liu等人（2014）的定义，且不受代理人信息与偏好的影响。反之则未必成立，即可能存在共同知识表明，一项不完全信息下的稳定配置并非完全信息下的稳定配置，但在熟悉的信息与偏好域内可被重新识别。这一特征化结果表明，不完全信息下的稳定性是可检验的，并与完全信息下的稳定性在观测上等价，同时该结论也适用于文献中提出的其他著名稳定性概念。
title: Epistemic implications of stable allocations
title_zh: 稳定配置的认识论含义

abstract: Employing a novel daily dataset for 19 advanced-economy currencies over the years 1963–2025, we find that, contrary to the prevailing view, deviations from the covered interest parity (CIP) condition were both large and frequent over the long-run. The 2000–06 period immediately preceding the Global Financial Crisis when CIP held unusually closely is therefore the exception rather than the period that followed. The long-run pattern in CIP deviations maps closely to measures of intermediary frictions and FX swap market imbalances. Our findings indicate that intermediary frictions have been a persistent feature of international financial markets over the past six decades.
abstract_zh: 利用1963年至2025年间19种发达经济体货币的新型日度数据集，我们发现，与主流观点相反，长期来看，对抛补利率平价（CIP）条件的偏离既大且频繁。因此，全球金融危机前夕的2000-06年期间，CIP异常紧密成立，实属例外，而非后续时期的常态。CIP偏离的长期模式与中介摩擦及外汇掉期市场失衡的度量紧密对应。我们的研究结果表明，过去六十年间，中介摩擦一直是国际金融市场的持久特征。
title: Covered Interest Parity: The Long Run Evidence
title_zh: 抛补利率平价：长期证据

abstract: We analyze the potential for electricity storage to substitute for transmission capacity. We develop a spatial-dynamic model of the grid where a utility manager dispatches generators and batteries to serve load at the lowest possible cost. The addition of storage requires the manager to optimize charging and discharging across the day, making the problem dynamic. We identify general conditions under which transmission and storage can serve as substitutes. When transmission is constrained and the battery is being charged or discharged, storage and transmission are substitutes at that instant. The investment-relevant capacity value depends on the aggregation of these instantaneous scarcity values across all hours of the day: storage substitutes for transmission investment when additional storage capacity reduces the time-averaged shadow value of the transmission constraint. This suggests storage can serve as transmission in markets where transmission is frequently constrained and the battery rarely sits idle. We calibrate our model to the electric grid in Texas and show that transmission and storage are substitutes even when wind generation is curtailed. The ability to substitute storage for transmission enables utilities to forgo costly and contentious grid expansion projects.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了电力存储替代输电能力的潜力。我们构建了一个电网的空间动态模型，其中公用事业管理者以最低成本调度发电机和电池以满足负荷。存储的加入要求管理者优化一天内的充放电操作，使问题具有动态性。我们识别了输电与存储能够作为替代品的一般条件。当输电受限且电池正在充电或放电时，存储与输电在该瞬间可视为替代品。与投资相关的容量价值取决于这些瞬时稀缺价值在一天内所有小时的聚合：当额外存储容量降低输电约束的时间平均影子价值时，存储替代输电投资。这表明，在输电频繁受限且电池很少闲置的市场中，存储可以充当输电的作用。我们将模型校准至德克萨斯州的电网，并显示即使风力发电被削减，输电与存储仍是替代品。存储替代输电的能力使公用事业能够避免昂贵且争议不断的电网扩建项目。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: Substituting Storage for Transmission: Implications for Renewable Energy
title_zh: 以储能替代输电：对可再生能源的影响

abstract: An increasing share of corporate loans, a critical source of firm credit, is sold off banks’ balance sheets and actively traded in a secondary over-the-counter market. We develop a microfounded equilibrium search-theoretic model with labor, credit, and financial markets to study the impact of this secondary loan market on the real economy. Our analysis highlights a policy-relevant trade-off: the market reduces the steady state level of unemployment by 0.21pp, but it also amplifies unemployment’s response to a 1% productivity drop by 0.07pp. Trading delays in the secondary market matter significantly: if trade were instantaneous, steady state unemployment and its volatility would decline by 1.49pp and by 0.24pp, respectively.
abstract_zh: 企业贷款作为企业信贷的关键来源，其日益增长的份额正从银行资产负债表中剥离，并在二级场外市场中活跃交易。我们构建了一个包含劳动力市场、信贷市场和金融市场的微观基础均衡搜索理论模型，以研究这一二级贷款市场对实体经济的影响。我们的分析揭示了一个具有政策相关性的权衡：该市场将稳态失业率降低了0.21个百分点，但同时将失业率对1%生产率下降的响应放大了0.07个百分点。二级市场中的交易延迟影响显著：若交易即时完成，稳态失业率及其波动性将分别下降1.49个百分点和0.24个百分点。
title: The effects of the secondary market for corporate loans on the real economy
title_zh: 公司贷款二级市场对实体经济的影响

abstract: We study how the announcement of a foreign military intervention, which improves expectations about the state’s future functioning, can raise citizens’ willingness to participate in state-building processes. We analyze the impact of the 2012 United Nations Security Council resolution that authorized intervention in Mali to reunify the country and restore democracy during a profound institutional crisis on individuals’ attitudes toward the state. By exploiting the randomness of the foreign intervention announcement relative to the timeline of the Afrobarometer interviews conducted in South Mali, we document that individuals interviewed in the days after the announcement report more optimistic beliefs about the country’s future level of democracy than individuals interviewed immediately before, with the same characteristics, region, and ethnic group. Consistent with a prospective-beliefs channel, respondents interviewed after the announcement report higher tax morale and more favorable tax-related attitudes across a broad range of outcomes. While optimism about future democracy increases widely, the increase in tax morale appears concentrated in areas with low state capacity, limited ethnic diversity, and individuals who do not perceive discrimination against their ethnic group. Our results indicate that foreign military interventions can enhance perceptions of state-building and the benefits of participation.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了外国军事干预的宣布如何通过改善对国家未来运作的预期，提升公民参与国家建设进程的意愿。我们分析了2012年联合国安理会授权在马里进行干预以在深刻制度危机期间实现国家统一和恢复民主的决议，对个人对国家态度的影响。利用外国干预宣布相对于南马里进行的非洲晴雨表访谈时间线的随机性，我们记录了在宣布后几天接受访谈的个人，相较于在宣布前立即接受访谈、具有相同特征、地区和族群的个体，报告了对国家未来民主水平更为乐观的信念。与前瞻性信念渠道一致，宣布后受访的个体在广泛的结果范围内报告了更高的税收道德和更有利的税收相关态度。尽管对未来民主的乐观情绪普遍上升，但税收道德的提高似乎集中在国家能力较低、族群多样性有限以及不认为自身族群受到歧视的个体所在的地区。我们的结果表明，外国军事干预可以增强对国家建设及参与益处的认知。
title: Expected foreign military intervention and demand for state-building: Evidence from Mali
title_zh: 预期外国军事干预与国家建设需求：来自马里的证据

abstract: A defining feature of many Community-Driven Development (CDD) interventions in wartorn countries is their pursuit of transformative objectives, seeking to (re)shape local decisionmaking institutions in the process. In recent years, there has been a push to overhaul CDD approaches, with a focus on more realistic objectives aimed at providing infrastructure and building capacity of existing local institutions. We investigate, through a large-scale field experiment involving 400 communities in eastern Congo, the effects of a CDD program that embodied this new focus. Our strategy allows us to identify causal impacts of the CDD intervention, in its basic form consisting of a US$100,000 envelope to finance an infrastructure project with an emphasis on ‘local content’, as well as when augmented with a complementary conflict mitigation component. While the intervention successfully delivered visible infrastructure projects, we find no detectable effects on social cohesion, (violent) conflict, or economic welfare. We conclude discussing policy implications.
abstract_zh: 许多饱受战争蹂躏国家中的社区驱动发展（CDD）干预措施的一个显著特征在于其追求变革性目标，旨在过程中（重新）塑造地方决策机构。近年来，推动了对CDD方法的改革，重点转向更为现实的目标，即提供基础设施并增强现有地方机构的能力。我们通过一项涉及刚果东部400个社区的大规模实地实验，考察了体现这一新重点的CDD项目的影响。我们的研究策略使我们能够识别CDD干预的因果效应，其基本形式包括一笔10万美元的资金用于资助一个强调“本地内容”的基础设施项目，以及当辅以一项补充性冲突缓解组成部分时的效果。尽管干预成功交付了可见的基础设施项目，但我们未发现对社会凝聚力、（暴力）冲突或经济福利有可检测的影响。最后，我们讨论了政策启示。
title: Building infrastructure and cohesion through locally embedded institutions: Evidence from a field experiment in War-torn Eastern Congo
title_zh: 通过地方嵌入制度构建基础设施与社会凝聚力：来自战乱刚果东部实地实验的证据

abstract: This paper provides a direct replication of Fehr et al. (2022), who examine whether information about individuals’ position in the global income distribution affects preferences over global inequality. Whereas the original study draws on a representative sample from Germany, we analyze a broadly representative UK sample ( N = 2116 ). UK respondents underestimate their global rank by about 2.4 deciles on average, yet randomly providing accurate rank information has no detectable effect on real-stakes donations to international anti-poverty NGOs or on policy attitudes toward global redistribution, international organizations, globalization, or immigration. The estimated average treatment effects are small, close to zero, and precisely estimated. A data-driven heterogeneity analysis reveals no sizable or systematic differences in subgroup responses. Overall, the results reinforce the evidence that correcting global income misperceptions alone is unlikely to shift preferences over global inequality in the European settings studied so far.
abstract_zh: 本文对Fehr等人（2022）的研究进行了直接复制，该研究探讨了关于个体在全球收入分配中位置的信息是否会影响其对全球不平等的偏好。原研究基于德国代表性样本，而我们则分析了一个广泛代表性的英国样本（N = 2116）。英国受访者平均低估其全球排名约2.4个十分位，但随机提供准确的排名信息对实际捐赠给国际反贫困非政府组织的行为，以及对全球再分配、国际组织、全球化或移民的政策态度，均未产生可检测的影响。估计的平均处理效应较小，接近于零，且估计精确。数据驱动的异质性分析显示，各子群体间不存在显著或系统性的差异。总体而言，研究结果进一步证实，在迄今研究的欧洲情境中，仅纠正全球收入认知偏差不太可能改变对全球不平等的偏好。
title: Relative income and global inequality: Evidence from the United Kingdom
title_zh: 相对收入与全球不平等：来自英国的证据

abstract: The existence of aggregate welfare gains from trade is one of the classic insights from international economics. However, these conventional welfare gains are static, in the sense that they take existing factor supplies and production technologies at a point in time as given. Recent research has highlighted dynamic effects of trade through endogenous factor accumulation and technological innovation over time, although there remains less consensus about the quantitative magnitude of these dynamic effects than about their static counterparts. Key insights from this research are that short-run and long-run responses to trade liberalization differ; capital accumulation amplifies the impact of international trade shocks; trade can facilitate technology adoption and the diffusion of ideas by changing the composition of suppliers; effects on lifetime welfare differ substantially from those on steady-state welfare, once transition dynamics are taken into account; and market failures can either magnify the overall welfare gains from trade or rationalize activist trade and industrial policies.
abstract_zh: 贸易带来的总体福利增益存在，是国际经济学中的经典洞见之一。然而，这些传统福利增益是静态的，即它们假定某一时点的要素供给和生产技术为既定。近期研究强调了贸易通过内生要素积累和技术创新随时间产生的动态效应，尽管对这些动态效应的量化规模共识程度不如静态对应效应。该研究的关键洞见包括：贸易自由化的短期与长期反应存在差异；资本积累放大国际贸易冲击的影响；贸易通过改变供应商构成促进技术采纳和思想传播；考虑转型动态后，对终身福利的影响与对稳态福利的影响显著不同；市场失灵可能放大贸易的总体福利增益，或为积极的贸易和产业政策提供合理性依据。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要讨论国际贸易的动态效应，未涉及中国数据、制度或政策背景，作者亦非中国机构，故不属中国研究。
title: Dynamic Effects of Trade
title_zh: 贸易的动态效应

abstract: We study income-related differences in tax-reported out-of-pocket healthcare expenditure using a unique database of more than 6 million tax records over five years. Individuals in the lowest income tax bracket report about €1,212 lower annual healthcare expenditure, excluding NHS tickets and disability expenditure, than those in the highest bracket after controlling for observable factors. Individual fixed-effects estimates show a positive within-taxpayer association between income and tax-reported healthcare expenditure, although these estimates should be interpreted as descriptive evidence rather than as causal estimates of unmet need. The income gradient is stronger among older taxpayers, and healthcare-expenditure income elasticities are up to three times higher in the lowest than in the highest income bracket. These patterns are consistent with the possibility that poorer taxpayers face tighter financial constraints in accessing private healthcare services. Higher-income individuals also report higher average costs for medical procedures and drugs, suggesting income-related differences in the composition and value of reported healthcare consumption. Since tax records measure declared, deductible and unreimbursed expenditure rather than actual healthcare needs or total healthcare consumption, the results should be read as evidence consistent with, but not definitive proof of, implicit healthcare expenditure rationing. The data were used exclusively for research purposes and were processed in compliance with the applicable confidentiality and data-protection requirements. abstract_zh: 我们利用一个包含五年间超过600万条税务记录的独特数据库，研究了与收入相关的税收申报自付医疗支出差异。在控制可观测因素后，最低所得税档位的个人年均医疗支出比最高档位低约1，212欧元，此差异不包括国家医疗服务体系（NHS）的票务费用和残疾相关支出。个体固定效应估计显示，在纳税人内部，收入与税收申报医疗支出之间存在正相关关系，尽管这些估计应被视为描述性证据，而非未满足需求的因果估计。收入梯度在年长纳税人中更为显著，且最低收入档位的医疗支出收入弹性最高可达最高档位的三倍。这些模式与较贫困纳税人在获取私人医疗服务时面临更紧的财务约束的可能性一致。高收入个体还报告了更高的医疗程序和药品平均成本，表明报告医疗消费的构成和价值存在收入相关差异。由于税务记录衡量的是申报的、可扣除且未报销的支出，而非实际医疗需求或总医疗消费，因此结果应被视为与隐性医疗支出配给一致的证据，而非最终证明。关键词：医疗配给 自付支出 收入相关不平等 自付医疗支出 JEL分类：I14 I11 I12 I18 H24 致谢：作者衷心感谢ACLI和CAF ACLI提供本研究所用的匿名行政税务申报数据。我们特别感谢他们支持提供关于税收申报医疗支出和纳税人特征的独特数据集，这使得分析意大利自付医疗支出的收入相关差异成为可能。数据仅用于研究目的，并按照适用的保密和数据保护要求进行处理。作者对分析、结果解释及任何遗留错误负全责。
title: Healthcare expenditure rationing: evidence from tax records
title_zh: 医疗支出配给：来自税收记录的证据

abstract: The study investigates the heterogeneity of the effect of COVID-19 pandemic-related restrictions on economic well-being in Russia based on labour market size, socio-demographic groups and income distribution. We examine the effect by composing a group of private-sector workers affected by pandemic-related restrictions in the labour market. We use public-sector workers as a counterfactual. Difference‑in‑differences, as the main approach, is combined with propensity score matching and applied to evaluate the average and quantile treatment effects. The results based on microdata from the RLMS-HSE reveal that the restrictions led to a loss of individual income of approximately 13%. However, the income decline was lower at the household level. In contrast to other crises, the pandemic led to significant income losses among working-age individuals, male workers and workers with secondary education. We note a negative effect on income in the top quantiles of the income distribution for the entire sample and in the median and lower quantiles for single-parent households and households with members who have severe health problems. The article contributes to the literature by identifying the heterogeneous effects of the pandemic restrictions in Russia and ruling out confounding factors. KEYWORDS: COVID-19 difference-in-differences quantile difference-in-differences equivalised income public–private sectoral gap JEL CLASSIFICATION: C21 D31 E24 Acknowledgements We express our gratitude to the two anonymous reviewers for their constructive comments.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了新冠疫情相关限制措施对俄罗斯经济福祉影响的异质性，基于劳动力市场规模、社会人口群体及收入分配维度进行分析。我们通过构建受疫情相关劳动力市场限制影响的私营部门工作者群体来考察该效应，并以公共部门工作者作为反事实参照。采用双重差分法作为主要分析方法，结合倾向得分匹配，评估平均处理效应与分位数处理效应。基于RLMS-HSE微观数据的实证结果显示，限制措施导致个人收入损失约13%，但家庭层面的收入下降幅度较小。与其他危机不同，疫情导致劳动年龄个体、男性工作者及中等教育水平工作者的收入显著损失。我们注意到，在全样本收入分布的高分位数处存在负向收入效应，而在单亲家庭及有严重健康问题成员的家庭中，中位数及低分位数处也呈现负向影响。本文通过识别俄罗斯疫情限制措施的异质性效应并排除混杂因素，为现有文献作出贡献。关键词：COVID-19；双重差分法；分位数双重差分法；等值收入；公共-私营部门差距 JEL分类：C21 D31 E24 致谢：我们感谢两位匿名审稿人的建设性意见。
title: The heterogeneous impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on income: evidence from Russia
title_zh: COVID-19疫情对收入的不均衡影响：来自俄罗斯的证据

abstract: Strengthening manufacturing industry chain resilience has become a strategic priority for China amid global supply-chain restructuring. This article investigates whether and how digital finance enhances manufacturing industry chain resilience, with particular attention to threshold-dependent nonlinearities shaped by labour market conditions. Using panel data on 30 Chinese provinces from 2011 to 2022, we employ two-way fixed-effects regressions, instrumental variable (IV) estimation and panel threshold models. The results show that digital finance significantly enhances manufacturing industry chain resilience. This effect is nonlinear: it intensifies in a stepwise manner as digital finance develops. Human capital amplifies the effect once average schooling exceeds a critical threshold, whereas labour market segmentation weakens it beyond a corresponding threshold. The benefits are also more pronounced in provinces with well-developed digital infrastructure and larger manufacturing scale. This study is the first to identify labour market segmentation as a threshold variable in the digital finance–resilience nexus. Theoretically, it shows that the resilience dividend of digital finance is conditional on both its own maturity and labour market institutions; practically, it offers guidance for sequencing digital finance and labour market reforms across regions. KEYWORDS: Digital finance industry chain resilience threshold effect human capital labour market segmentation JEL CLASSIFICATION: G21 L60 J24 R12
abstract_zh: 在全球供应链重构背景下，增强制造业产业链韧性已成为中国的战略优先事项。本文考察数字金融是否以及如何提升制造业产业链韧性，特别关注劳动力市场条件所塑造的门限依赖型非线性特征。基于2011至2022年中国30个省份的面板数据，本文采用双向固定效应回归、工具变量（IV）估计和面板门限模型。研究结果表明，数字金融显著增强制造业产业链韧性。该效应具有非线性特征：随着数字金融的发展，其效应呈阶梯式增强。当平均受教育年限超过临界阈值时，人力资本会放大该效应；而当劳动力市场分割超过相应阈值时，则会削弱该效应。此外，在数字基础设施完善和制造业规模较大的省份，该效应更为显著。本研究首次将劳动力市场分割识别为数字金融—韧性关联中的门限变量。在理论上，本文揭示了数字金融的韧性红利取决于其自身成熟度与劳动力市场制度的双重条件；在实践上，为各地区数字金融与劳动力市场改革的时序安排提供了政策参考。关键词：数字金融；产业链韧性；门限效应；人力资本；劳动力市场分割 JEL分类号：G21 L60 J24 R12

title: The impact of digital finance on manufacturing industry chain resilience: a labour market perspective
title_zh: 数字金融对制造业产业链韧性的影响：基于劳动力市场的视角

abstract: Using data from 29 regional housing markets in China, this study examines the long-run relationships between housing prices and key macroeconomic variables. Conventional cointegration methods can be misleading, as estimated coefficients often contradict standard demand–supply theory even when statistical tests indicate cointegration. Among the variables, only real income consistently explains regional housing price dynamics, whereas real interest rates and building costs fail to do so consistently across markets. Region-specific models reveal substantial heterogeneity and are both statistically robust and economically meaningful. Panel cointegration tests that account for cross-sectional dependence fail to detect cointegration when such heterogeneity is ignored. These findings highlight the limitations of uniform national approaches and underscore the need for tailored, region-specific housing policies. KEYWORDS: Housing market cointegration dynamic ordinary least squares panel cointegration test with CSD disaggregated regional data JEL CLASSIFICATION: R30 E00 C51
abstract_zh: 本研究利用中国29个区域住房市场的数据，探讨了房价与关键宏观经济变量之间的长期关系。传统的协整方法可能产生误导，因为即便统计检验表明存在协整，估计系数也常常与标准供需理论相悖。在各类变量中，仅实际收入能一致地解释区域房价动态，而实际利率和建筑成本则无法在各市场间保持一致的解释力。区域特定模型揭示了显著的异质性，既在统计上稳健，又在经济上具有意义。当忽略这种异质性时，考虑横截面依赖性的面板协整检验未能检测到协整关系。这些发现凸显了统一全国性方法的局限性，并强调了制定针对性的区域住房政策的必要性。关键词：住房市场协整 动态普通最小二乘法 考虑横截面依赖性的面板协整检验 分类区域数据 JEL分类：R30 E00 C51

title: When cointegration misleads: regional evidence on the determinants of housing prices in China

abstract: Informality remains one of the most persistent challenges for land governance, particularly where large-scale legalization policies seek to reconcile existing development with formal planning and regulatory systems. Although zoning amnesties often generate comprehensive administrative records of informal development, they rarely establish institutional mechanisms capable of transforming legitimization into sustainable legalization. This study examines the implementation outcomes of Türkiye's 2018 Zoning Amnesty and evaluates how they provide the foundation for a governance model for structured legalization. An integrated analytical framework combining spatial assessment, institutional analysis, and policy evaluation was applied using national administrative statistics, orthophoto-based spatial analysis, municipal inventories, zoning-amnesty datasets, and evidence from the environmentally sensitive Uzungöl case study. The findings demonstrate that the Building Registration Certificate functioned primarily as an instrument of institutional legitimization rather than complete legalization, creating a nationwide administrative inventory while leaving critical planning, technical, environmental, and legal issues unresolved. Building on these findings, the study proposes a governance model that transforms administrative legitimization into structured legalization through a sequential institutional pathway integrating legal verification, spatial assessment, technical and environmental assessment, and administrative integration. The proposed model offers a transferable approach for more transparent, adaptive, and risk-informed land governance in countries facing similar challenges of large-scale informality.
abstract_zh: 非正规性仍然是土地治理中最持久的挑战之一，尤其是在大规模合法化政策试图将现有发展与正式规划和监管体系相协调的情况下。尽管分区特赦常常产生非正规发展的全面行政记录，但它们很少建立能够将合法化转化为可持续法律化的制度机制。本研究考察了土耳其2018年分区特赦的实施结果，并评估了它们如何为结构化合法化的治理模式奠定基础。采用结合空间评估、制度分析和政策评估的综合分析框架，利用国家行政统计、基于正射影像的空间分析、市政清单、分区特赦数据集以及环境敏感的乌宗格尔案例研究证据。研究结果表明，建筑登记证书主要作为制度合法化的工具而非完全法律化，在全国范围内建立了行政清单，同时留下了关键的规划、技术、环境和法律问题未解决。基于这些发现，研究提出了一种治理模式，通过整合法律验证、空间评估、技术和环境评估以及行政整合的序列化制度路径，将行政合法化转化为结构化法律化。所提出的模式为面临类似大规模非正规性挑战的国家提供了一种可转移的方法，以实现更透明、适应性强和风险知情的土地治理。
title: From legitimization to structured legalization: A governance framework from Türkiye’s 2018 zoning amnesty
title_zh: 从合法化到结构化法治：土耳其2018年区划特赦的治理框架

abstract: Using Iranian household microdata and welfare metrics grounded in consumer theory, we show that the 2012 SWIFT sanctions inflicted unequal welfare losses. Poorer households lost 2.3–2.8 times more than wealthier ones (quartile comparison) in terms of pre‐sanctions real expenditure. Public‐sector households needed 35%–41% more compensation than private‐sector peers; manufacturing/services households needed 37%–42% more than agriculture/construction households. Financial sanctions hurt the poor most, reversing oil sanctions predictions.
abstract_zh: 利用伊朗家庭微观数据及基于消费者理论的福利度量指标，我们揭示2012年SWIFT制裁造成了不平等的福利损失。以制裁前实际支出衡量，较贫困家庭（按四分位比较）的损失是较富裕家庭的2.3至2.8倍。公共部门家庭所需补偿比私营部门同行高出35%至41%；制造业/服务业家庭所需补偿比农业/建筑业家庭高出37%至42%。金融制裁对贫困群体冲击最大，这一结果与石油制裁的预测相反。
title: Sanctions and Household Welfare: Evidence From Iran
title_zh: 制裁与家庭福利：来自伊朗的证据

abstract: In 1932, Joseph Duncan argued in the Journal of Agricultural Economics that agricultural economists should engage more explicitly with politics. Nearly a century later, the political economy of food and agriculture has expanded in both scope and complexity. This paper revisits the evolution of political economy perspectives on agricultural policy, tracing the shift from early interest‐based explanations centered on farmers and consumers to broader frameworks that incorporate institutions, ideas and the interactions among diverse policy actors. We argue that contemporary transitions from an agricultural policy paradigm to a food systems one require a further rethinking of political economy analysis. Specifically, contemporary food systems pursue multiple and often competing objectives, including productivity, nutrition, environmental sustainability, resilience and equity, while involving a far wider array of stakeholders, from multinational corporations and transnational advocacy networks to technology firms and global governance institutions. At the same time, rising political polarization, populism, digital misinformation and the fragmentation of multilateral governance increasingly shape how policy preferences are formed, coalitions are constructed, and policy compromises are negotiated. These developments complicate traditional assumptions that preferences are driven primarily by material interests and that institutions can reliably facilitate collective action. We illustrate these changing dynamics through brief case studies of the 2024 European farmer protests, Brazil's Amazon Soy Moratorium and Mexico's genetically modified corn dispute. Each case highlights tensions between national sovereignty, global integration, environmental sustainability, and agricultural livelihoods. We conclude that understanding twenty‐first century food policy requires political economy frameworks that integrate interests, institutions, ideas and the changing geopolitical and informational context in which food system decisions are made.
abstract_zh: 1932年，约瑟夫·邓肯在《农业经济学杂志》上提出，农业经济学家应更明确地参与政治。近一个世纪后，食品与农业的政治经济学在范围和复杂性上均有所扩展。本文回顾了农业政策政治经济学视角的演变，追溯了从早期以农民和消费者为中心的利益解释，到纳入制度、思想及多元政策行动者互动的更广泛框架的转变。我们认为，当代从农业政策范式向食品系统范式的转型，要求对政治经济学分析进行进一步反思。具体而言，当代食品系统追求多重且往往相互竞争的目标，包括生产力、营养、环境可持续性、韧性和公平，同时涉及从跨国公司、跨国倡导网络到科技企业和全球治理机构等更为广泛的利益相关者。与此同时，日益加剧的政治极化、民粹主义、数字虚假信息以及多边治理的碎片化，正日益影响政策偏好的形成、联盟的构建以及政策妥协的谈判方式。这些发展使传统假设——即偏好主要由物质利益驱动，且制度能够可靠地促进集体行动——变得复杂化。我们通过2024年欧洲农民抗议、巴西亚马逊大豆暂停令以及墨西哥转基因玉米争端的简要案例研究，阐释了这些变化中的动态。每个案例都凸显了国家主权、全球一体化、环境可持续性与农业生计之间的张力。我们得出结论，理解21世纪的食品政策需要整合利益、制度、思想以及食品系统决策所处的不断变化的地缘政治和信息背景的政治经济学框架。
title: Revisiting the Political Economy of Agriculture in 21st Century Food Systems
title_zh: 重访21世纪粮食系统中的农业政治经济学

abstract: Evaluation systems often seek to reduce bias, prevent manipulation, preserve relevant information, maintain comparability, and treat candidates equally, but these fairness goals can conflict. This paper develops a framework for understanding such trade-offs in expert evaluation—including peer review, grant panels, academic hiring, and artistic competitions—where quality is multidimensional and legitimate disagreement among evaluators is possible. We treat the choice among evaluation procedures as a problem of constitutional design: rules must be selected before the specific candidates, evaluators, and circumstances that will test them are known. Classical music competitions are our primary analytical setting because their rules, scores, and controversies make these trade-offs unusually visible, but the framework applies to other settings in which expert judgments are aggregated under incomplete information. The framework highlights two core tensions: information control and outlier rules. First, when information is both quality-relevant and identity-revealing, procedures that suppress bias-relevant cues may also remove information with genuine evaluative content. Second, because sincere minority judgment and strategic manipulation can generate similar observed score patterns, score-based exclusion rules may reduce manipulation while limiting legitimate dissent. Two further trade-offs concerning transparency and standardization are developed as illustrations. The analysis shows that no procedure can eliminate all vulnerabilities at once. Beyond this design implication, the framework also helps explain why evaluation rules differ across stages and settings, and why well-intentioned reforms may create new vulnerabilities.
abstract_zh: 评估体系往往力求减少偏见、防止操纵、保留相关信息、维持可比性并平等对待候选人，但这些公平目标之间可能相互冲突。本文构建了一个框架，用以理解专家评估中的此类权衡——包括同行评审、资助评审小组、学术招聘和艺术竞赛——在这些场景中，质量是多维度的，且评审者之间存在合理的意见分歧。我们将评估程序的选择视为一项宪法设计问题：规则必须在具体候选人、评审者及可能检验这些规则的情境被知晓之前选定。古典音乐比赛是我们的主要分析场景，因为其规则、评分和争议使这些权衡异常清晰可见，但该框架同样适用于其他在信息不完整条件下汇总专家判断的情境。该框架突出了两个核心张力：信息控制与离群值规则。首先，当信息既与质量相关又揭示身份时，抑制偏见相关线索的程序也可能移除具有真实评价内容的信息。其次，由于真诚的少数派判断与策略性操纵可能产生相似的观察得分模式，基于得分的排除规则可能在减少操纵的同时限制合法的异议。另外两个关于透明度和标准化的权衡作为示例加以阐述。分析表明，没有任何程序能同时消除所有脆弱性。除这一设计启示外，该框架还有助于解释为何评估规则在不同阶段和情境中存在差异，以及为何出于善意的改革可能引发新的脆弱性。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Fairness trade-offs in expert evaluation: information, judgment, and procedural design
title_zh: 专家评价中的公平性权衡：信息、判断与程序设计

abstract: Hydrogeological disasters are an increasingly important source of fiscal stress for local governments, yet evidence on how municipal budgets adjust to these events remains limited. This paper estimates the fiscal effects of hydrogeological State of Emergency declarations on Italian municipal budgets over 2016–2022, exploiting their staggered timing across municipalities. We find that treated municipalities increase both total revenues and total expenditures after first exposure. The response is primarily investment-led, with capital expenditures accounting for the largest estimated component of the adjustment while current expenditures remain broadly unchanged. The largest changes in expenditure composition involve civil protection activities and sustainable development. On the revenue side, the adjustment is driven mainly by capital revenues and intergovernmental transfers. We further examine municipal heterogeneity using an ex-ante measure of fiscal resilience based on debt-service burden and tax autonomy. Municipalities with lower debt-service burden display sharper immediate fiscal adjustments, whereas tax autonomy matters more for sustaining the fiscal response over time. The weakest responses are observed among municipalities combining high debt-service burden with weak tax autonomy. Overall, the evidence suggests that hydrogeological emergencies trigger a structured, investment-led fiscal response, but that pre-existing fiscal conditions shape local governments’ capacity to absorb and manage these disaster-related fiscal pressures.
abstract_zh: 水文地质灾害日益成为地方政府财政压力的重要来源，然而关于市政预算如何应对这些事件的证据仍然有限。本文利用2016至2022年间意大利各市镇宣布水文地质紧急状态的交错时间安排，估计了其对市政预算的财政影响。我们发现，首次经历此类事件后，受影响的市镇总收入和总支出均有所增加。这一反应主要以投资为导向，资本支出构成调整中最大的估计组成部分，而经常性支出基本保持不变。支出结构变化最大的领域涉及民防活动和可持续发展。在收入方面，调整主要由资本收入和政府间转移支付驱动。我们进一步利用基于债务负担和税收自主权的事前财政韧性指标考察了市镇间的异质性。债务负担较低的市镇表现出更明显的即时财政调整，而税收自主权对维持财政反应的持续性更为重要。在债务负担高且税收自主权弱的市镇中，财政反应最为微弱。总体而言，证据表明水文地质紧急事件触发了结构化的、以投资为导向的财政反应，但既有的财政状况塑造了地方政府吸收和管理这些灾害相关财政压力的能力。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Floods, Public Budgets and Fiscal Resilience: Evidence from Italian Municipalities
title_zh: 洪水、公共预算与财政韧性：来自意大利市政的证据

abstract: This paper investigates the impacts of housing purchase restrictions on internal migration and household tenure choices in Chinese cities. We develop a spatial model that incorporates individuals’ migration and tenure decisions across cities. The model predicts that potentially affected homebuyers will either switch destinations or change tenure choices, depending on heterogeneous city characteristics. Utilizing the China Migrants Dynamic Survey and a difference-in-differences approach, we examine the model’s implications and find that the restrictions lead to a decrease in migration inflows and a reduced proportion of homeowners among migrants in the restricted cities relative to the unrestricted ones. However, this overall pattern masks important heterogeneity across cities: incoming migrants are more likely to adjust their tenure choices when restricted cities offer better development prospects or desirable living conditions, and they are more inclined to relocate to alternative destinations when such attributes are lacking. These findings highlight the importance of considering unintended consequences on migration when designing housing policies.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了住房购买限制对中国城市内部迁移及家庭住房产权选择的影响。我们构建了一个空间模型，该模型整合了个人跨城市的迁移与产权决策。模型预测，受潜在影响的购房者将根据城市特征的异质性，要么转换目的地，要么调整产权选择。利用中国流动人口动态监测调查数据及双重差分方法，我们检验了模型的推论，发现相较于未受限城市，限制措施导致受限城市的迁移流入量减少，且迁移者中房屋所有者的比例下降。然而，这一总体趋势掩盖了城市间的重要差异：当受限城市提供更好的发展前景或宜居条件时，迁入的迁移者更可能调整其产权选择；而当这些特质缺失时，他们则更倾向于转向其他目的地。这些发现强调了在设计住房政策时考虑对迁移产生的非预期后果的重要性。

abstract: When observing spatial data, what standard errors should we report? Within a finite population framework, we identify three channels of possible spatial correlation: sampling scheme, assignment design, and model specification. The Eicker-Huber-White standard error, cluster-robust standard error, and spatial-correlation robust inference are compared under different combinations of the three channels. We prove a finite population central limit theorem for weakly dependent random fields that bridges the gap between superpopulation and finite population inference in our unified framework. These limit theorems are then applied to derive the asymptotic distribution of M-estimators and functions of M-estimators. Based on the decomposition of the finite population variance-covariance matrix of M-estimators, standard errors should be adjusted for spatial correlation when effective assignment variables are spatially correlated and/or spillover effects are specified in the model. In the special case where the sampling probabilities approach zero in the limit, the Eicker-Huber-White and cluster-robust standard errors would be close to the spatial-correlation robust standard errors regardless of the spatial correlation among assignment variables.
abstract_zh: 在观测空间数据时，我们应报告何种标准误？在有限总体框架内，我们识别了可能产生空间相关性的三个渠道：抽样方案、分配设计和模型设定。我们比较了在不同组合下的Eicker-Huber-White标准误、聚类稳健标准误和空间相关稳健推断。我们证明了弱依赖随机场的有限总体中心极限定理，该定理在我们的统一框架中弥合了超总体与有限总体推断之间的差距。这些极限定理随后被应用于推导M估计量及其函数的渐近分布。基于M估计量有限总体方差-协方差矩阵的分解，当有效分配变量存在空间相关性且/或模型中设定了溢出效应时，标准误应针对空间相关性进行调整。在抽样概率极限趋近于零的特殊情况下，无论分配变量间的空间相关性如何，Eicker-Huber-White和聚类稳健标准误将接近空间相关稳健标准误。
title: A design-based approach to spatial correlation
title_zh: 基于设计的方法处理空间相关性

abstract: Conventional approaches to policy design fail to recognise the plasticity of citizens’ beliefs and social preferences. Based on a representative sample from Germany, this column shows that mandated carbon-reducing lifestyle changes such as limiting heating and the use of cars in city centres may crowd out pre-existing green values. Effective climate policy design requires recognising that (a) to succeed, essential policies including bans, carbon taxes, and the promotion of new technologies must be both implementable and politically sustainable, entailing (b) a critical role for citizens’ green values, which (c) may be either diminished or cultivated, depending on policy design.
abstract_zh: 传统的政策设计方法未能认识到公民信念和社会偏好的可塑性。基于德国代表性样本，本专栏指出，诸如限制供暖和市中心汽车使用等强制性的碳减排生活方式改变，可能会挤出既有的绿色价值观。有效的气候政策设计需认识到：（a）要取得成功，包括禁令、碳税及新技术推广在内的关键政策必须既可行又具有政治可持续性，这要求（b）公民的绿色价值观发挥关键作用，而（c）这些价值观可能因政策设计的不同而被削弱或培育。
title: Climate policy may crowd out green values and what to do about it
title_zh: 气候政策可能挤出绿色价值观及其应对之策

abstract: Economists have long viewed monetary policy as influencing labour demand, with little effect on labour supply. This column discusses four studies that use different methods and data from the US, the UK, the euro area, and Australia, and independently find that monetary tightening induces households to adjust their labour supply. Adjustment margins include hours worked, labour market participation, job search, and household balance sheets. These findings illustrate that labour supply is a quantitatively meaningful channel of monetary transmission that has implications for the resilience of labour markets, the interaction of monetary and fiscal policy, and macroeconomic models of monetary transmission.
abstract_zh: 经济学家长期以来将货币政策视为影响劳动力需求的因素，而对劳动力供给的影响甚微。本专栏讨论了四项研究，这些研究采用不同方法和来自美国、英国、欧元区及澳大利亚的数据，并独立发现货币紧缩促使家庭调整其劳动力供给。调整的边际包括工作时间、劳动力市场参与度、求职活动以及家庭资产负债表。这些发现表明，劳动力供给是货币传导中一个数量上重要的渠道，对劳动力市场的韧性、货币与财政政策的相互作用以及货币传导的宏观经济模型具有启示意义。
authors: Francesco Bloise, Cristiano Cantore, Mitali Das, Filippo Ferroni, Sebastian Graves, Jonathan Hambur, Klaus Hellwig, Christopher Huckfeldt, Mirko Licchetta, Haroon Mumtaz, Giuseppe Ragusa, John Spray, Eric T. Swanson, Angeliki Theophilopoulou
title: Uncovering the labour supply channel of monetary transmission
title_zh: 揭示货币政策传导的劳动供给渠道

abstract: We show that product and service quality serve as a hidden margin of adjustment to minimum wage hikes in hyper-competitive digital markets. Leveraging granular trans- action data from 2628 Tmall stores in rural China from 2015 to 2020, combined with household surveys and firm-level data, we exploit staggered city-level minimum wage in- creases and find that in the short run, firms neither reduce employment nor significantly raise prices. Instead, they systematically degrade quality, as evidenced by worse product ratings, slower logistics, and poorer customer service, starting within two quarters and per- sisting over time. The reduction in intermediate inputs compromises product quality, while cuts to outsourced IT services undermine service quality by weakening operational effi- ciency. Crucially, this decline is driven by high-quality incumbents, whereas low-quality firms show no change but are more likely to exit the market following the shock. These re- sults reveal a trade-off between labor income and consumer welfare, a cost that is invisible in traditional labor market evaluations but central to a complete welfare assessment.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，在高度竞争的数字市场中，产品和服务质量构成了对最低工资上调的一种隐性调整边际。利用2015年至2020年中国农村2628家天猫店铺的细粒度交易数据，结合家庭调查和企业层面数据，我们利用城市层面最低工资的分阶段上调，发现短期内企业既未减少就业，也未显著提高价格。相反，他们系统性地降低了质量，表现为产品评分下降、物流速度减慢和客户服务变差，这些变化在两个月内开始显现并持续存在。中间投入的减少损害了产品质量，而外包IT服务的削减则通过削弱运营效率损害了服务质量。关键在于，这种下降是由高质量在位企业驱动的，而低质量企业虽无变化，但在冲击后更可能退出市场。这些结果揭示了劳动收入与消费者福利之间的权衡，这一成本在传统劳动力市场评估中不可见，但对于全面的福利评估至关重要。

title: When wages rise, quality falls: Minimum wages and the hidden trade-off in competitive e-commerce markets
title_zh: 工资上涨，质量下降：最低工资与竞争性电商市场中的隐性权衡

abstract: A novel feature of platforms such as marketplaces and social networks is that nonparticipants may become worse off as others join. We show that in such settings, rational agents can be induced to join a platform despite being better off without it—a phenomenon we call a platform trap. We provide a theory of how platform traps emerge through one or more of the following additional features: (i) the ability of the platform to make dynamic price adjustments; (ii) the interplay between on-platform and off-platform negative externalities; (iii) favorable equilibrium selection in settings where participation decisions admit multiple equilibria.
abstract_zh: 平台（如市场和社会网络）的一个新颖特征是，非参与者可能因他人加入而境况恶化。我们证明，在此类情境下，理性个体即便在无平台时境况更佳，也可能被诱导加入平台——我们将此现象称为“平台陷阱”。我们提供了一种理论，阐述平台陷阱如何通过以下一个或多个附加特征形成：（i）平台进行动态价格调整的能力；（ii）平台内外负外部性的相互作用；（iii）在参与决策允许多重均衡的情境中，有利的均衡选择。
title: Platform Traps
title_zh: 平台陷阱

abstract: The study of bureaucracy as a key dimension of state capacity has gained increasing attention in economics. What organizational features create an effective bureaucracy, however, remains subject to debate. This paper focuses on the central role of civil service protections in delineating the boundary between politics and administration. I introduce a simple principal-agent framework to discuss the key theoretical channels through which political insulation can shape bureaucrat performance. Guided by the framework, I establish stylized facts and organize evidence from historical and contemporary civil service reforms. Overall, the micro-level evidence documents a positive effect of civil service protections on the quality of public service delivery. I conclude with open questions about the political economy of reform adoption.
abstract_zh: 官僚制作为国家能力的关键维度，其在经济学中的研究日益受到关注。然而，何种组织特征能够塑造有效的官僚体系，仍是争论焦点。本文聚焦于公务员保护在界定政治与行政边界中的核心作用。我引入一个简洁的委托-代理框架，探讨政治隔离影响官僚绩效的主要理论途径。在此框架指导下，我确立了若干典型事实，并系统整理了历史及当代公务员制度改革的相关证据。总体而言，微观层面的证据表明，公务员保护对公共服务供给质量具有积极影响。最后，我提出关于改革采纳的政治经济学未解问题。
title: The Economics of Civil Service Protections
title_zh: 公务员保护的经济学分析
